Bludgeoning.description: Heavy kinetic impact that breaks bones and ruptures organs (e.g., Hooves, Tails, Hammers).

Piercing.description: Deep tissue penetration targeting vital organs (e.g., Horns, Fangs, Stingers).

Slashing.description: Clean, deep severing of muscle and limbs (e.g., Bear claws, Swords).

Shredding.description: Frantic surface-level tearing and flaying of skin/scales (e.g., Piranha teeth, Raptor claws).

Poison.description: Toxic substance injected into the bloodstream disrupting biological functions (e.g., Vipers, Spiders).

Acid.description: Caustic chemical reaction that melts armor and flesh from the outside (e.g., Bombardier Beetles, Slimes).

Disease.description: Pathogenic or viral infection that rapidly decays the immune system (e.g., Komodo Dragons, Fetid Swamps).

Fire.description: Extreme thermal energy causing rapid cellular combustion.

Cold.description: Extreme thermal deprivation shattering frozen tissue and slowing kinetics.

Lightning.description: High-voltage electrical discharge that overrides the nervous system (e.g., Electric Eels).

Sonic.description: Concentrated acoustic shockwaves that shatter crystalline structures and rupture eardrums (e.g., Bat Screeches, Whales).

Hydraulic.description: Crushing, high-velocity water pressure (e.g., Pistol Shrimp snaps, Deep Ocean currents).

Arcane.description: Raw, unstable magical energy that unravels the fabric of reality.

Necrotic.description: Dark energy that instantly withers living matter and drains life force.

Radiant.description: Blinding, purifying light that burns undead and fiendish entities.

Psychic.description: Direct mental assault bypassing physical armor to damage the mind.

Asphyxiation.description: Oxygen deprivation via constriction, drowning, or toxic gas. Bypasses standard armor.

True.description: Absolute unblockable damage. Ignores all resistances, shields, and armor. Use sparingly.

Healing.description: Restorative energy applied with op: add on hp. Not a destructive type.
